A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the mean measurement accuracy for localization of UHF transponders in the 3 m ×3 m test area is improved from 0.21 to 0.11 m by using spatial diversity and the proposed RSS-based selection algorithm.
the localization accuracy of UHF RFID transponder can be improved significantly by using spatial diversity in the measurement setup.
the mean measurement error of the AoA based approach can be reduced from 0.21 to 0.1 m using the proposed algorithm.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a spatial diversity based localization approach can achieve a mean accuracy of about 10 cm for UHF RFID tags in indoor environments using a single RFID reader IC.
it is feasible to localize RFID transponders with an accuracy of 0,3 m using an off-the-shelf UHF RFID reader IC and an antenna array with only three antenna positions.
it is possible to improve the accuracy of AoA based localization using spatial diversity.
